item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Rate limit grouping for Azure Front Door Premium WAF
item.description:
Azure Front Door Premium WAF now supports rate limit grouping in public preview. This lets rate limit rules aggregate requests across a group instead of counting only per client IP, which helps with distributed attacks.

  • Source: Azure Updates
